name: Chalet Belvedere
beschreibung:
Chalet Belvedere welcomes guests in a peaceful setting with far-reaching vistas over the sunny Paznaun valley. Its comfortably furnished lodgings offer the perfect haven for families and mountain enthusiasts.

In summer, idyllic alpine meadows and hiking trails await, while in winter the renowned ski areas of Kappl and Ischgl can be reached within minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Belvedere in Kappl features alpine comfort and breathtaking valley views across the Paznaun region.
